models_evaluated: autonomous AI diabetic retinal exam system (FDA De Novo)

links.outcome: Rate of nondiagnostic (ungradable) results in real-world autonomous AI retinal exams
links.effect: Of 241 patients, 123 (51%) had nondiagnostic results; T1D (aOR 5.82), smoking (aOR 2.86), and age per 10 years (aOR 2.12) were associated with nondiagnostic results.
links.quote: Of 241 patients (59% female; median age = 59), 123 (51%) had nondiagnostic results.

unlisted_practices: Predictive dilation workflow: pharmacologically dilate patients predicted likely to have nondiagnostic AI retinal images a priori (predictive model AUC 0.76 in five-fold cross-validation)

screen.reason: Retrospective study of an autonomous AI diabetic retinopathy screening tool deployed in real-world clinical care to identify causes of non-diagnostic images and propose a predictive dilation workflow.
